digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate, G7 criterion routing and blocking
propositions: G7 routing entry carries default_posture 'advisory' at block_threshold 0.95, preventing blocking; must flip to default_posture 'blocking' with block_threshold 0.85 to enable blocking for 348 historical findings with 22 correct and 0 clearly-incorrect at priority >= 0.85

G7 rubric must emit ABSTAIN with coverage on unresolvable parent (never a finding) and scope closed parents against final state with sibling-handoff carve-out to eliminate false positives on ticket 18f9 and similar cases
G7 rubric must enforce one finding per contradicted parent clause (DEDUP-AT-SOURCE pattern from c97a T5c) to prevent same-issue duplicates stacking as observed on ticket 76d2

Plan-review blocking at 0.85 admits both contradicts_reality and omits_required_site floor kinds (impact floor 0.85) via existing divergence grading (ADR 0054); incomplete_enumeration cannot reach 0.85 bar (impact 0.55) and remains advisory, eliminating cosmetic divergence false positives

Floor-kind guidance and rubric text must be added to plan_review_G7.md to clarify that only genuine contract contradictions or provably required omissions block; wording mismatches are incomplete_enumeration

Pinned routing table, blocking-set union via new G7_BLOCKING constant, _PLAN_REVIEW_APPROVED_BLOCKING set, and test_plan_review_g7.py posture pin must all reflect G7 at (0.85, 'blocking'); criteria guide must be regenerated
